label: From the shop
text: Maps, games and printables that make kids look around — and turn “we went somewhere” into a day they remember.

items.title: Panoramic map of Prague Castle
items.text: Works as a guide and a game in one. Available in Czech and English, with a free animal hunt.

items.title: Animal hunt at St Vitus Cathedral
items.text: A printable PDF: owls, fish and other creatures hidden in stone and metal that most people walk past.

items.title: To je Praha — the book to have at home
items.text: If we had to pick one book to start discovering Prague with kids, it would be this one.
